source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. A cozy tavern where adventurers gather and companions are recruited: warm firelight, clinking mugs, a foot-tapping jig. Tempo 116 BPM, 6/8 time, key of D major. Instrumentation: fiddle and tin whistle melody, clarinet, strummed guitar, stomping frame drum (bodhran), upright bass. Form: jig A, jig B, back to A. Duration: 60 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
